body.p: Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration of this application in view of the

foregoing amendments and the following remarks. Claims 1-20 are currently pending and stand rejected. Claims 1 and 11 are currently amended. Support for the amendments may be found throughout the specification and drawings, for example at paragraph [0018] of the specification. No new subject matter has been added. No claims have been cancelled and no new claims have been added.
Applicant thanks Examiner Flory for the indication that claims 3, 4, 10, 13, 14, and 20 are allowable and respectfully submits that all claims are now in condition for allowance.
Claims 1-20 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 112(b) as the term "typical" in claims 1 and 11 is a relative term which renders those claims indefinite.
Claims 1 and 11 have been amended to overcome the rejections under 35 U.S.C. 112 as shown hereinabove. Withdrawal of these rejections is respectfully requested.
Claims 1, 2, 5-9, 11, 12, and 15-19 are rejected on the ground of nonstatutory double patenting as being unpatentable over claims 1-23 of U.S. Patent No. 11,103,176.
Claims 1, 2, 5-9, 11, 12, and 15-19 are rejected on the ground of nonstatutory double patenting as being unpatentable over claims 1-23 of U.S. Patent No. 10,478,084.
Claims 1, 2, 5-9, 11, 12, and 15-19 are rejected on the ground of nonstatutory double patenting as being unpatentable over claims 1-42 of U.S. Patent No. 9,254,095.
Terminal disclaimers directed to U.S. Patent Nos. 11,103,176, 10,478,084 and 9,254,095 are being filed herewith. Withdrawal of these rejections is respectfully requested.

In conclusion, Applicant respectfully submits that in view of the amendments and remarks set forth herein, the applicable rejections/objections have been overcome and the application is in condition for allowance.

The Examiner is invited to telephone the undersigned attorney to resolve any issues and expedite prosecution. Please charge any shortages and credit any overcharges to our Deposit Account No. 09-0528.
Respectfully submitted, Womble Bond Dickinson (US) LLP
